item.title: Missouri appeals court upholds $800,000 award in delivery van crash case
item.description: A Missouri appeals court upheld an $800,000 jury verdict in favor of Amy Bolandis following a traffic accident. It was determined that the delivery van driver failed to check for oncoming vehicles before merging into Bolandis's lane, leading to the collision. The court ruled decisively that Bolandis was not speeding, emphasizing the responsibility of all drivers to prioritize safety when entering traffic. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Crossing Afghanistan along the 'highway of death'
item.description: Highway 1, or the Ring Road, connects Afghanistan's major cities. After September 11, 2001, it became a hotspot for crime and fighting, particularly between the capital Kabul and Kandahar, the Taliban's birthplace. People taking it had to navigate extortions, kidnappings and suicide bombings. What has become of the road after the US-led war and five years of Taliban rule? Our former Afghanistan correspondent Claire Billet and photojournalist Sandra Calligaro returned to the country to find out. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: Claire BILLET
